boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Indiana University-Bloomington
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Bloomington food stops with official hours extending to midnight or later on at least one night each week.

cards.title: Chicken on Kirkwood Until 1
cards.subtitle: 422 East Kirkwood Avenue
cards.notes: Walk east along Kirkwood for dine-in service; check the separate walk-up-window schedule if you plan to order outside.
cards.short_summary: A campus-edge chicken counter with midnight closing daily and an extra hour on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: The official location page lists dine-in hours through midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 422 East Kirkwood Avenue.
cards.source_title: Raising Cane's in Bloomington, IN — 422 East Kirkwood Avenue
cards.access_notes: Dine-in closes at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the walk-up window closes one hour earlier.

cards.title: Kirkwood Sandwiches After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 430 East Kirkwood Avenue
cards.notes: Use the Kirkwood storefront for pickup or indoor seating, and confirm the day because Saturday and Sunday close earlier.
cards.short_summary: A sandwich shop beside the campus end of Kirkwood with service as late as 3:00 a.m. on Thursday and Friday.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's official store page lists closing at 1:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Friday at 430 East Kirkwood Avenue.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Bloomington | Jimmy John's 0379
cards.access_notes: Open until 1:00 a.m. Monday–Wednesday and 3:00 a.m. Thursday–Friday; Saturday and Sunday close at 10:00 p.m.

cards.title: A 3 A.M. Tenth Street Option
cards.subtitle: 1827 East 10th Street
cards.notes: Head east on Tenth Street for pickup or delivery; verify the live store page before leaving because hours can change.
cards.short_summary: An east-of-campus sandwich location whose official page currently shows 3:00 a.m. service every day.
cards.evidence_claim: Jimmy John's official location page lists store and delivery hours through 3:00 a.m. every day at 1827 East 10th Street.
cards.source_title: Sandwich Shop & Gourmet Subs in Bloomington | Jimmy John's 380
cards.access_notes: The official location page lists both store and delivery service until 3:00 a.m. Monday–Sunday.

cards.title: Downtown Pizza Until 3
cards.subtitle: 312 East Third Street
cards.notes: Use the downtown counter for the latest Pizza X schedule near campus; expect shorter hours earlier in the week.
cards.short_summary: A Third Street pizza shop open through midnight early in the week and 3:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza X's official locations page lists Downtown at 312 East Third Street, open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza X Locations | 7 Locations Across Bloomington & Ellettsville
cards.access_notes: Closes at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; student-break hours may vary.

cards.title: West Third Street Until 3
cards.subtitle: 1610 West Third Street
cards.notes: Choose this location when your route runs west of downtown, and check for student-break changes before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A west-side Pizza X branch matching the downtown shop's midnight-to-3:00 a.m. closing pattern.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza X's official locations page lists its West shop at 1610 West Third Street, closing at midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza X Locations | 7 Locations Across Bloomington & Ellettsville
cards.access_notes: Closes at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; student-break hours may vary.

cards.title: South-Side Pizza After Midnight
cards.subtitle: 2443 South Walnut Street Pike
cards.notes: Use the South Walnut Street Pike shop for a south-side run; confirm hours during university vacation periods.
cards.short_summary: A south Bloomington pizza counter serving until midnight or later, with 3:00 a.m. closings on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza X's official locations page lists its South shop at 2443 South Walnut Street Pike, open until midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza X Locations | 7 Locations Across Bloomington & Ellettsville
cards.access_notes: Closes at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; student-break hours may vary.

cards.title: College Mall Road Until 3
cards.subtitle: 877 South College Mall Road
cards.notes: Pair this stop with an east-side route, and consult the official page for possible schedule changes during breaks.
cards.short_summary: An east Bloomington Pizza X location with midnight service early in the week and 3:00 a.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza X's official locations page lists its East shop at 877 South College Mall Road, closing at midnight Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Pizza X Locations | 7 Locations Across Bloomington & Ellettsville
cards.access_notes: Closes at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Wednesday, 1:00 a.m. Thursday, and 3:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; student-break hours may vary.

cards.title: A Midnight South-Side Drive
cards.subtitle: 4001 South Old State Road 37
cards.notes: Plan on a drive south of central Bloomington; both restaurant and drive-through follow the same posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: A south Bloomington fast-food stop open through midnight nightly and 1:00 a.m. on Friday and Saturday.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy's official location page lists restaurant and drive-through hours until midnight Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Wendy's 4001 South Old State Road 37 in Bloomington, IN
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through close at 12:00 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 1:00 a.m. Friday–Saturday; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Breakfast at Any Hour
cards.subtitle: 410 South College Mall Road
cards.notes: Take an east-side trip for a seated meal overnight; the official page lists dine-in and takeout among its amenities.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour pancake restaurant offering an all-night sit-down option east of the university district.
cards.evidence_claim: IHOP's official Bloomington location page identifies 410 South College Mall Road as open 24 hours Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: IHOP Breakfast in Bloomington, IN on 410 S College Mall Road
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours Monday–Sunday, with dine-in, takeout, curbside pickup, and online ordering listed on the official page.

cards.entity_name: The Market at Hyatt Place Bloomington
cards.title: A 24-Hour Grab-and-Go Shelf
cards.subtitle: 217 West Kirkwood Avenue
cards.notes: Enter Hyatt Place and ask for The Market; choose from packaged snacks, salads, pastries, and other grab-and-go items.
cards.short_summary: A hotel market on West Kirkwood providing a round-the-clock alternative to a full restaurant visit.
cards.evidence_claim: Hyatt's official dining page lists The Market at Hyatt Place Bloomington, 217 West Kirkwood Avenue, as open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The Market is open 24 hours and sells packaged grab-and-go food; availability of individual items may vary.

warnings: Pizza X states that store hours may vary during student breaks; users should confirm the live schedule before visiting.
